name: Diffacto
tagline: Compare changes in code, spreadsheets, images, and other files on your Mac.
description:
Diffacto compares two versions of a file and reports the changes it identifies. It can match rows in tables, compare images visually, and inspect changes in documents and code.

## Privacy and requirements
Diffacto requires Apple Silicon and macOS 15 or later. The developer says comparisons run locally. Optional share links and cloud summaries send data when you choose those features.

## Pricing
A free tier is available. Pro is $149 as a one-time purchase with one year of updates. Monthly and annual options are also available.
pricingDetails: Free, Pro $149 one-time or $96 per year
